purpose: Source acquisition plan; not a downloaded or legally validated rule corpus.

sources.name: Local Government Directory (LGD)
sources.data: Official location identifiers, local bodies, wards and administrative relationships.
sources.access: Use directory downloads; complete any CAPTCHA manually.
sources.reuse: Published LGD policy permits accurate, attributed reproduction, excluding third-party content. Policy was inspected on an official LGD demo mirror; reconfirm the production policy before bulk collection.
sources.limitation: Directory identifiers are not permit criteria or a guaranteed parcel-level boundary dataset.

sources.name: Survey of India (SoI)
sources.data: State, district and subdistrict boundaries; use verified local sources for municipal and ward detail.
sources.access: Acquire the relevant download/product and inspect its metadata and access conditions.
sources.reuse: Check product-specific terms. Follow SoI standards for India political-boundary depiction; public availability alone is not a blanket reuse licence.
sources.limitation: Do not use coarse national geometry to claim precise ward or property-level jurisdiction.

sources.name: Hubballi-Dharwad City Corporation
sources.data: Manual listings for trade licence, signage and other municipal applications.
sources.access: Read and download relevant manuals, then verify the operative requirements and amendments.
sources.reuse: The published policy allows accurate, attributed reproduction without specific permission, excluding identified third-party content.
sources.limitation: The manuals page is dated 19 October 2023. It is a source lead, not proof that every rule is current.

sources.name: Bengaluru North City Corporation
sources.data: Municipal service links, notifications, and a ward/corporation location facility.
sources.access: Follow official service and notification links; verify the authority for the actual venue.
sources.reuse: Published site policy permits accurate, attributed reproduction, with third-party exclusions. Separate linked sites and map layers need their own rights check.
sources.limitation: An interactive boundary viewer is not, by itself, permission to extract its underlying dataset.

sources.name: Open Government Data Platform India
sources.data: Optional supporting open datasets and statistics, selected at resource level.
sources.access: Use the download or API provided for a relevant resource.
sources.reuse: GODL-India permits lawful reuse and adaptation of covered data with provider, source and licence attribution; observe exclusions and non-endorsement.
sources.limitation: Permit statistics are not eligibility rules. No nationwide permit-rule dataset is assumed.

sources.name: India Code
sources.data: Central and state legislation and subordinate material such as rules and notifications.
sources.access: Search the relevant law, jurisdiction and amendments; cite exact sections.
sources.reuse: Public reference source. Check current copyright and usage terms before copying a corpus or redistributing documents.
sources.limitation: A law must be interpreted with applicability, commencement and amendments; do not treat a search result as a complete rule set.

sources.name: Karnataka e-Rajyapatra
sources.data: Karnataka gazette notifications, including departmental publications and changes.
sources.access: Search by department, date and subject; retain document identity and publication date.
sources.reuse: Public reference source; no blanket republication or bulk-extraction permission is asserted here.
sources.limitation: Pages may require browser interaction. Publication date and legal effective date can differ.

sources.name: Gazette of India
sources.access: Locate the applicable notification and preserve its issue, section and date.
sources.reuse: The portal describes free public access but also copyright. Free access is not unrestricted permission to republish or scrape.
sources.limitation: Only include central requirements that are relevant to the selected activity.

sources.name: FSSAI FoSCoS
sources.data: Food-business licence document requirements, including category-specific conditions.
sources.access: Inspect the correct business category and current official notifications.
sources.reuse: Public reference source; verify reuse terms separately before ingesting documents at scale.
sources.limitation: Food licensing is not the same as a municipal trade licence. Do not invent turnover, attendance or certificate thresholds.

sources.name: National Single Window System (NSWS)
sources.data: Discovery of potentially relevant central and state business approvals.
sources.access: Use Know Your Approvals to identify departments and follow the issuing authority sources.
sources.reuse: Treat as a discovery/reference service; check its terms before automated extraction.
sources.limitation: NSWS explicitly describes this output as indicative guidance, not a final legal determination.

sources.name: Karnataka Vyapar trade-licence portal
sources.data: Published application fields and document categories, including district, urban local body and ward.
sources.access: Inspect public forms only; do not access applicant records or submit applications.
sources.reuse: Confirm applicable portal terms before copying form content or automating access.
sources.limitation: A field or upload option on a form does not prove it is mandatory for every applicant.

technical_references.name: Amazon Bedrock: client-side tool use
technical_references.note: Supports model-requested tools executed by application code. The application controls permissions and validation.

technical_references.name: AWS Step Functions: execution details
technical_references.note: Documents graph/table views and execution history. Use actual workflow status for the demo.

technical_references.name: Amazon Location: Places APIs
technical_references.note: Place search, geocoding and related location APIs; not a substitute for reviewed jurisdiction mappings.

technical_references.name: Amazon Location: API-key restrictions
technical_references.note: Restrict keys by permitted actions/resources and client domains; use a short-lived, least-privilege configuration.

technical_references.name: MapLibre GL JS: GeoJSON polygons
technical_references.note: Supports polygon fill layers for the map. The renderer licence and the geographical dataset licence are separate.

technical_references.name: Amazon S3: object versioning
technical_references.note: Retains object versions. Legal effective dates and approval status remain application metadata.

technical_references.name: Excalidraw: scene utilities
technical_references.note: Documents JSON scene serialization and import/export utilities for editable diagrams.
